Part A: pairs with 11 <= P(n) <= 31 after Lemma 5.4

checkpoints.explanation: We get one extra pair, (30, 699). It passes Lemmas 6.1, 6.2, 6.3 and 5.4 as we read them: 5^2 | (a+1), 3^3 | (a+3) with nu_3(n) = 1, and n + a = 3^6. No Newton polygon excludes it either (the right-most slope is >= 1 for p = 2, 3, 5). It is closed by factorisation: the polynomial is irreducible.

(n, a) = (896, 979): candidates left by Proposition 1.3 (paper: xi = 2770, not a root)
checkpoints.explanation: Our candidate list also requires Rad(n(n+a)) | xi (Remark 2 of the paper). Here Rad(896 * 1875) = 210 does not divide 2770, so 2770 is already excluded and no candidate is left. The conclusion (no integer root) is the same.
